_source: Derived from app/(nos)/ on the nos-pagehero head (30cb1e1a) and the nos-pagehero crop-map.json nosRoutes. Paths are NOS-host paths (nos.localhost), as the nos-pagehero gates use them. Every directory under app/(nos)/ and app/(shared)/{privacy,terms,refunds,newsletter/unsubscribe} has an entry; the catch-all [...slug] and the dynamic [slug] / [year] pages are reached by discovery.

conditional.reason: removed by SAOC #90 (88693ec2): now a 308 redirect to /vendors, which is swept in its own right; if it answers 200 it is swept, otherwise logged NOT SWEPT
data-dependent: 404s when the archive has no visible past shows (past-shows-public); the 404 is then swept as the not-found page
gated: redirects (307) to the admin login in the gate environment; an /admin landing is not a NOS surface and is skipped
token-dependent legal page; swept when it renders
needs a payment reference; swept when it renders
short alias of /vendors/payment/status; swept when it renders

discover.label: tickets/[slug] (the first real product link, as the nos-pagehero gates discover it)
hub destination links (reaches any show page the catch-all [...slug] serves)

notFoundRoutes.source: an unmatched nos-host URL renders app/not-found.tsx (NosFrame, NosThemeScope, NosPageNotFound on the nos host, per origin/main c020ad1d #93)
TK-404: an unknown ticket slug must answer 404 and render the NOS not-found (typographic NosHero title) exactly as an unmatched route does
an unrecorded archive year (or a withheld archive) answers 404 with the NOS not-found; /national-show/archive/<year> 308s to /archive/<year> on the nos host

notFoundNote: Both resolve to app/(nos)/national-show/not-found.tsx (NosPageNotFound). On the #76 head that file is a NosSection with an h1 `nos-opsz-fluid` clamp(28px, 3.6vw, 44px) at weight 400 (NOS Design's 44px/400 reading); on origin/main after #93 it is a typographic NosHero whose h1 is `.nos-hero-title`, already weight 300. The gate is behavioural, so it holds for either markup.
dynamicSegmentsNote: Every directory under app/(nos) whose name is a dynamic segment ([param]) must be a key here with a bad-param path in notFoundRoutes; gate-not-found.mjs fails on an unlisted one, so a new dynamic NOS route cannot ship without its bad-param 404 being swept. On origin/main c020ad1d the only two are tickets/[slug] and national-show/archive/[year].

validTicketProbe.note: a real ticket slug found on the hub must still answer 200 (the fix must not 404 live products); logged NOT CHECKED when the hub offers no such link
